A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 56-page paper, including Appendices A–H. Full text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical content apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its associated link.

before.justification: Section 4 of v2.pdf reports original experiments: over 80% effective proposed lemmas across approximately 100 experimental rounds, tests with GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Pro, and a reflection ablation. Table 2 reports the system's iterative results.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix E of v3.pdf retain the same original lemma-generation experiments, backbone tests, reflection ablation and iterative results.

M1.justification: The lemma-generation procedure, verification-function reward model, branch-and-bound certification and bottleneck-reflection loop are identical in Section 3 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions investigate the same Euclidean Steiner-ratio task and the same four geometric verification cases in Appendix D.2. No datasets, domains or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Section 4 retains the same reflection-disabled comparator. No comparison method is added, removed or revised in the reported experiments.

E3.justification: The GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Pro settings, ten-round reflection ablation, four verification cases and representative Case 2 evaluation regime remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The backbone robustness tests, reflection ablation and representative trajectory analysis in Section 4 are identical. Appendix analyses of verification bottlenecks and geometric regimes are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Experiment-count disclosures and statistical reporting are identical. Neither version supplies seed lists, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 2 and Figure 9 retain the identical nine-step sequence from 0.8282 to 0.8559. Both versions also report over 80% effective lemmas and no lower-bound improvement over ten iterations without reflection.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, theorems and proofs are identical, including the vertex-maximum theorem, generated-lemma proofs in Appendix E and final certificate argument in Appendix H.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about an LLM-assisted geometric-lemma system, a certified Steiner-ratio lower bound of 0.8559 and discovery using thousands of LLM calls.

C2.justification: Interpretations of structured search and reflection are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same substantive limitations concerning symbolic-verification scalability and mandatory human verification.

D1.justification: Algorithm pseudocode, implementation details, prompts, resource estimates and code/certificate access information are identical. The code and certificate hyperlink targets are unchanged.

R1.justification: The references and Appendix A are identical, retaining the same positioning relative to earlier Steiner-ratio bounds, automated theorem proving and AI-assisted scientific discovery.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2, dated 21 May 2026, to v3, dated 2 September 2026. This is a limited metadata-text edit; body prose, headings, authors and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions and their placement are identical. Rendered pages 2–56 match pixel-for-pixel, and page 1 matches outside the arXiv stamp described under P1.

improvement.justification: The later PDF reproduces the same scientific content, empirical evidence, proofs, explanations and limitations, including all appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its link has no meaningful effect on overall paper quality.
